one_liner: The four-seam fastball is the pitch thrown in every count: 31.78% of all pitches in the 2025 pull, and its usage barely tilts by leverage (27.6% when ahead vs 29.0% when behind).
three_things: It is the sport's default: 220,235 four-seamers, 31.78% of everything thrown.
Leverage barely moves it -- 27.6% ahead, 43.3% even, 29.0% behind -- the flattest count profile of the four pitches profiled here.
Median velocity 94.5 mph; outcomes split 49.6% strike, 34.0% ball, 16.4% in play.
context_note: Descriptive only, over a single 2025 Statcast pull. The count-leverage shares are of this pitch's OWN usage (what share of four-seamers fall in each leverage class) -- they are not the share of any given count that is a four-seam. The strike bucket merges called, swinging, and foul strikes (no per-pitch swing/take in this corpus), so it is not a whiff rate. 'Flattest of these four' is scoped to the four pitch types written up in this pack. Not a prediction; no edge claim.
